featured_reviews.name: Vivek Vetal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Persian Darbar in Byculla after hearing a lot of buzz around it. Given its reputation and the constant crowd outside, my expectations were naturally quite high. However, my overall experience was somewhat mixed.

To start with the positives — the ambience is genuinely good. The interiors are well done, with a spacious seating layout and a proper family-restaurant vibe. It feels grand and lively, which explains the heavy footfall. Do note that the place is almost always crowded. If you’re planning to visit, I would strongly recommend booking a table in advance or reaching a little early to avoid the long waiting time.

Coming to the food — I tried the Moroccan Kebab, Murgh Lebnani, Murgh Zafrani Tikka, Bihari Boti, and Chicken Biryani. Honestly, I found most of the dishes average. The taste and quality were mediocre, nothing extraordinary— the kind of flavour you can easily find at many other restaurants on the same street. Given the hype around the place, I expected something more distinctive or memorable. The Moroccan Kebab and Murgh variants were okay, but they didn’t stand out in terms of spice balance or uniqueness. The Bihari Boti was a bit undercooked.

The Chicken Biryani was comparatively better than the rest — flavorful, well-cooked rice, and properly spiced. It was the highlight of the meal for me.

Service, however, was quite slow — probably because of the constant rush. Staff were polite, but you’ll need some patience.

Overall, I felt the place is slightly overhyped. If you’re a hardcore foodie looking for exceptional flavours, you can skip it. If you do visit, go with limited expectations about the taste and focus more on the ambience and overall experience rather than culinary excellence.

Gloria Restaurant is a must-visit for seafood and non-veg lovers. The place truly shines when it comes to bold flavours and perfectly cooked dishes. The Peshawari Tandoori stands out with its smoky aroma and tender texture, cooked to perfection. But the real showstopper, and easily the all-time best, is their Chicken Oysted—rich, flavourful, and unforgettable. It’s the kind of dish that keeps you coming back.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Jondhale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently dined at Gloria Restaurant and Stores and had the pleasure of trying their chicken tikka biryani and chicken tandoori lollipop. It was an exceptional culinary experience that I thoroughly enjoyed.

Chicken Tikka Biryani:
The chicken tikka biryani was outstanding. The biryani rice was fragrant and cooked to perfection, with each grain separate and infused with aromatic spices. The chicken tikka pieces were succulent and well-marinated, offering a delightful smoky flavor that complemented the spices in the rice beautifully. The dish had a perfect balance of heat and flavor, making it a treat for the taste buds. The addition of caramelized onions and fresh coriander as garnishes added an extra layer of texture and taste. It was served with a side of cooling raita, which was a refreshing contrast to the rich and spicy biryani.

Chicken Tandoori Lollipop:
The chicken tandoori lollipop was enjoyable as well, with its unique tandoori flavor and slightly smoky taste. However, I personally prefer the traditional oil-fried lollipop, as it provides a distinct crispiness and flavor that appeals more to my taste.

Ambiance and Service:
The ambiance at Gloria Restaurant and Stores is inviting and pleasant, with a comfortable seating arrangement that is perfect for both small and large groups. The decor is simple yet tasteful, creating a cozy dining atmosphere. The service was prompt and attentive, with the staff being courteous and keen on ensuring a pleasant dining experience.

Overall Experience:
In summary, my experience at Gloria Restaurant and Stores was highly enjoyable. The chicken tikka biryani was a standout dish, characterized by its rich flavors and excellent preparation. The chicken tandoori lollipop was good, though I personally lean toward the traditional oil-fried version. The warm ambiance and attentive service further enhanced the dining experience. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a delicious and satisfying meal. I look forward to returning and exploring more of their menu offerings.

Experience a blend of authentic south indian traditional flavors with modern twists at Beyond Idlis. Our menu includes classic dishes like Idli, Vada, Upma, and more, along with a variety of Dosas and Andhra Cuisine specials like Dibba Roti, Mysore Bonda, Pesarattu. We also offer Mumbaikars favorites like Panipuri, Mirchi Pav, Pav Bhaji and Misal Pav!

Our unique specialties are the array of Chutneys like coconut, peanut, ginger, gunpowder and curry leaf powder and an authentic sambar that is served along. Come visit us and enjoy the authenticity.

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Keyal
featured_reviews.review_text: This newly opened small restaurant in south bombay has literally won my heart with the food and service they provide. Honestly I didnt expect much but it far exceeded my expectations. I would honestly recommend you their ghee roast dosa which was soo yummy and crispy. Secondly their idli platter which had varieties of idlis in it. You cannot miss on the filter coffee whenever you visit any south indian restaurant. Looking forward to visiting here soon!

2. onion uthappa - the taste was bomb

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Wadke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ambience-5/5⭐️ Ambience is short and simple. You will get a local cafe feeling. The seatings suits the theme of the place.

Food - 5/5⭐️ This place serves a lomg range of variety in south indian dishes. Starting from their signature idlis to Authentic lemon rice. They have covered all the major dishes. We tried the following dishes.
1. Mysore Bonda 9/10
2. Panniyaram 10/10
3. Tomato Rice 10/10 (Must Try)
4. Beyond idli special Uttappa 10/10
5. Ghee Roast Dosa 10/10
6. Filter Kaafi

First of all every dish was prepared after we ordered the food thats the reason it was really tasting so fresh and delicious. We personally liked the mysore bonda and tomato rice. Also the main highlight of the this place is its price. The prices are too pocket friendly. The quality of food this place serves is really admirable. Do visit this place with your friends and family.

featured_reviews.name: Vinit Surve
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried ghee roast dosa and sandwich uttapan from Beyond Idlis. The dosa was perfectly roasted in ghee. With coconut chutney and sambar, it tasted so good. The ghee roast just enhanced the flavor. The sandwich uttapan was also tasty. Both dishes were good enough in quantity. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Let's eat Mumbai!!!
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beyond idlis is the place where you can try real south indian food!

I tried their medu wada which was crispy outside and soft inside.

Their paniyarums were so fluffy and tasted well with this spicy chutney.

The sandwich uttappa was so flavourful and fulfilling. Its a must try!

Lastly,  i tried their pav bhaji.. it was spicy. Just the way i liked!

Overall,  the cafe has delicious variety of morning breakfast!

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Gurav
featured_reviews.review_text:
South Indian food lover’s must visit Beyond Idlis located at Lower Parel. One of the best place to have south indian breakfast. Ambience is awesome. Its a sweet and small cafe❤️. We order some delicious food items from the menu…
Stuffed mirchi
Panniyaram
South Indian Thali
Beyond Idli Special Uthappa😋💯
Above mentioned dishes were very yummy and delicious. The main thing is the food was fresh and the place is very hygienic. Pricing of the dishes is unbelievable. Each and Every item starts from just Rs 50/- . Comfortable seating arrangements. The service is very good with cooperative staff.
My overall experience was the best with Beyond Idlis. Must visit with your friends, family and loved ones❤️💯
DO VISIT💯

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: The one thing I must say that this place is seriously like a heaven in terms of the south indian food. You will find many of the traditional south indian dishes as well as many of the unique dishes too. My favourite was the spot idli and the mysore masala dosa. The mysore masala dosa what you get at this place is really very delicious and quite different. They have an AC seating area. Also the price of all their dishes are extremely pocket-friendy. Also the price to portion size was perfect. A must visit place if you are near lower parel railway station
